name: OpenMetadata
summary: Emit Ogun run lineage as OpenLineage events to an OpenMetadata server, authenticated with an ingestion bot JWT.

fields.name: bot_jwt
fields.label: Bot JWT
fields.help: Copied from the bot's page in OpenMetadata; sent as a bearer token. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: url
settings.label: OpenMetadata URL
settings.help: Base URL of the OpenMetadata server.

settings.name: path
settings.label: OpenLineage path
settings.help: Where your OpenMetadata version accepts OpenLineage events. Check the vendor documentation.

settings.name: namespace
settings.label: Namespace
settings.help: OpenLineage namespace for Ogun jobs and datasets.

egress.note: The host of the url setting, on the port in the url.

notes: Ogun sends OpenLineage run events with Ogun facets for artifacts and windows, through an outbox (ADR 0012). The path has no default because OpenLineage intake depends on the OpenMetadata version and deployment: check the vendor documentation. This build reaches http:// endpoints only.
